library.decoded: (6 amine heads C1-C6 x 2 alkyl acrylates O1/O2 = 12 synthesized cores, plus 5 commercial cores SM-102/OF-2/TT3/MC3/Lipid 14) x 3 cholesterol tails B1/B2/B3 = 51
library.note_486: The abstract's '486 LNPs' is a FORMULATION screen (molar-ratio DoE around the lead), not 486 distinct lipids. Only the top 14 formulations are tabulated (Table S1, and it is an image).

structures.not_enumerated: 15 commercial-core lipids (names recorded; SMILES available from the existing corpus rather than re-read)
structures.stoichiometry_evidence: NMR, not assumed: C6O2 shows delta 4.04 (t, 10H) = 5 ester OCH2 and delta 0.87 (t, 15H) = 5 terminal CH3, confirming FIVE acrylate arms, exactly the 5 N-H sites in the C6 head. C6O2B2 retains both integrals and adds cholesterol signatures (5.30 d 1H, 4.54 m 1H C3-H, 0.61 s 3H C18-Me).
structures.confidence_flags: O1 (branched isodecyl) is figure-only and flagged medium; the B1/B2/B3 ester connectivity is inferred from the C3-H shift and flagged medium. O2 is pinned by NMR integrals.

NOT_extracted.fig2h_per_point: 486 dots overlap heavily (194 components for 486 points) and carry no formulation labels; used as a distribution check only

fig2c_486_formulation_screen.what_the_486_are: ONE lipid (C6O2B2) formulated 486 ways: C6O2B2 35/50/65 x DODAP 10/30/50 x helper 10/30/50 x DMG-PEG 1/2/4 (=81) x 6 helper identities (DOPC,DMPC,DOPG,DOPE,EggSM,DSPC) = 486. Zero structural variance; this is a formulation axis, not a chemistry axis.
fig2c_486_formulation_screen.assay: luciferase, IGROV-1 cells, 20 ng mLuc per well, 24 h, n=3
fig2c_486_formulation_screen.extraction: Fig 2c, six 9x9 heatmaps. Legend is DISCRETE 4-bin (<1e4 / 1e4-1e5 / 1e5-1e6 / >1e6), so cells are nearest-neighbour matched to swatches sampled from the legend in the same raster. Grid geometry taken from detected cell gridlines, not an assumed bbox.

verification.marginals_vs_printed_bar_charts: ALL FOUR EXACT. Fig 2d by C6O2B2 41/21/31, Fig 2e by DMG-PEG 35/29/29, Fig 2f by DODAP 8/31/54, Fig 2g by helper 3/17/16/9/13/35 - 15 of 15 bins match the digitized counts with zero deviation.
verification.orientation_confirmed_by: the row-axis marginals are non-monotone (41/21/31) and monotone (8/31/54) respectively, so an outer/inner swap or a transposition would break them. Both match, so the axis assignment is verified structurally, not just read off the labels.
verification.discrepancy_vs_prose: The paper TEXT says 240 acceptable and 91 outstanding. Digitization gives 238 and 93. But the papers OWN bar charts sum to 93 outstanding on all four marginals independently, and the totals agree exactly (238+93 = 240+91 = 331 cells at or above 1e5). The prose is off by two at the 1e6 boundary; the figures and this digitization agree.

fig2c_486_formulation_screen.caveat: bin_index is the defensible quantity. rlu_midpoint is a geometric half-decade placeholder for numeric convenience and must not be treated as a measured value.

structure_corrections_2026_10_29.found_by: independent adversarial verifier subagent; all three confirmed by me against Fig 1b/2a and RDKit before fixing
structure_corrections_2026_10_29.E1_cholesterol_attachment: quaternize() did CHOL.replace('(O)','',1) and concatenated the acyl in FRONT of the result. SMILES concatenation bonds to the FIRST atom, so the ester oxygen attached to a terminal methyl of the isooctyl side chain - the opposite end of the steroid from C3. Fig 1b and Fig 2a draw the ester on C3 (3-beta wedge), and the SI NMR C3-H at delta 4.5-4.7 confirms esterification (free cholesterol C3-H is 3.5). FIXED: the C3 oxygen is kept and esterified.
structure_corrections_2026_10_29.E2_radical_carbon: deleting the hydroxyl left C3 two-coordinate with one H and ONE RADICAL ELECTRON in all 36 structures, and the 3-beta stereocentre was lost. Formula and MolWt were each 1 H / 1.008 Da low. FIXED.
structure_corrections_2026_10_29.E3_quaternization_site: the docstring said 'most substituted tertiary N' but the code took max(atom index), an artifact of SMILES writing order. For C6 it picked the terminal N bearing two beta-amino-ester arms - the LEAST nucleophilic nitrogen - while Fig 2a plainly shows the N+ is a PIPERAZINE RING nitrogen. FIXED: prefer a ring N, then fewest beta-ester arms, then atom index. C5/C6 now match Fig 2a; C1-C4 have no ring N, the paper draws no structure, and those 24 rows are flagged quaternization_site_assumed=1 with confidence 'low'.
structure_corrections_2026_10_29.why_the_checks_missed_it: HRMS/formula checks cannot see connectivity, and the oxygen count was unchanged by E1 - only the hydrogen count moved, by one. The structures parsed, canonicalised, and had self-consistent descriptors, so every existing audit check passed. provenance/audit.py check C1 now tests for radical electrons.
structure_corrections_2026_10_29.corpus_impact: 537 rows (486 vitro + 51 vivo) carried wrong structures; all regenerated.
